sentences.text: Centrornis majori was an extinct species of large goose belonging to the shelduck subfamily.
The species was described from subfossil remains found in central Madagascar that were radiocarbon dated to approximately 17,000 years ago.
There are three recorded fossil occurrences of Centrornis in the Paleobiology Database.
The genus Centrornis was established by Andrews in 1897.
Centrornis is classified within the family Anatidae.
Centrornis lived from the Late Pleistocene through the Holocene, spanning from 0.129 to 0 million years ago.
